svg.text: 32 px — full canonical master; X = 3 px on a 30 px optical box (X/2 gap renders at 1.5 px).
24 px — full canonical master; X = 2 px on a 20 px optical box, every edge on a whole pixel.
16 px — DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION. Reduced 8X two-frame micro master, X = 2 px;
f3 and its BOTTOM gate omitted. TOP and LEFT gates retained.
The full master requires an even X so the X/2 gap lands on whole pixels.
